scope: Supplied workflow-v5 authoring contracts, gold claim identities, evidence locators, source dossiers and pristine source-derived tables only. No model outputs or inference.
observed_defect: Every prior case contains exactly one unresolved claim, commonly phrased as whether a quantity is identifiable. Absence of disclosure and uncertainty about economic value are conflated.
decision: Replace those assertions with source-grounded known facts, explicit disclosure claims and undecidable economic assertions. Keep single verdicts on new tasks and preserve prior claims in historical scoring.

a01.assertion: The supplied segment-results table reports Azure-only operating income for Q2 FY2025 separately from Intelligent Cloud operating income.
a01.source_grounded_reason: The complete segment table reports Intelligent Cloud operating income of USD 10,851 million and no Azure-only operating-income line. Azure is separately disclosed as business revenue growth, which cannot substitute for segment profit.

a02.assertion: Using the issuer free-cash-flow definition, free cash flow for the first nine months of FY2025 was USD 29,508 million.
a02.source_grounded_reason: Subtract Q4 from annual operating cash, property purchases and finance-lease principal, preserving the cash-outflow signs. This tests duration and issuer-definition reconciliation without repeating the annual direction claim.

a03.assertion: Reserve-yield changes contributed more than half of the FY2024-to-FY2025 change in reserve income.
a03.source_grounded_reason: The supplied operations provide annual reserve income. The definitions state that yield and average circulation both affect reserve income, but do not provide the separate constant-balance rate contribution needed to decide this causal majority claim.

a04.assertion: The supplied cash-flow statement contains a separate FY2025 cash property-purchase amount for artificial-intelligence projects.
a04.source_grounded_reason: The cash-flow statement has total property purchases. The narrative says the increase is primarily for artificial intelligence without a precise project allocation. The claim describes a line in the supplied document, so its absence from the complete supplied table is a contradiction, not an unresolved economic amount.

a05.assertion: Earned membership fees for the first 36 weeks of FY2025 were USD 3,599 million.
a05.source_grounded_reason: Both the annual 52-week and Q4 16-week membership-fee observations are supplied. Annual less Q4 gives the matching first-36-week flow and does not estimate cash collections.

a06.assertion: The supplied cash-flow dossier contains both six-month and nine-month operating cash flow, allowing Q3 operating cash flow to be obtained by subtraction.
a06.source_grounded_reason: The dossier explicitly supplies nine-month cash flows and no six-month cash-flow statement. The income statement has different durations and cannot supply the missing cash-flow input.

a07.assertion: NVIDIA made no H20 shipments to China during Q3 FY2026.
a07.source_grounded_reason: The supplied Q2 release contains a Q3 guidance assumption of no China H20 shipments. It supplies no realized Q3 shipments, so neither zero nor nonzero actual shipments are established.

a08.assertion: Subtracting the disclosed Informatica contribution from FY2026 total revenue gives an arithmetic current-period revenue amount of USD 41,126 million.
a08.source_grounded_reason: Total FY2026 revenue is subscription/support plus professional services. Removing the USD 399 million disclosed acquisition contribution gives a defined arithmetic scope adjustment, without claiming exact organic constant-currency growth.

a09.assertion: Disney Q4 FY2025 DTC revenue growth would have been positive with Star India excluded from both comparison periods.
a09.source_grounded_reason: The source establishes deconsolidation and explains multiple DTC growth factors. It does not provide the common-scope two-period DTC amounts needed to determine the sign of this counterfactual growth claim.

a10.assertion: Using the supplied annual values, FY2025 discount revenue divided by billed business is approximately 2.24 percent.
a10.source_grounded_reason: Annual discount revenue is in USD million and billed business is in USD billion. Their descriptive ratio can be computed even though it does not identify causal pricing.

b01.assertion: More SBC units were transferred in payments during June 2025 than were in circulation at the June 30 observation.
b01.source_grounded_reason: The reports supply month-end issued-supply and reserve stocks. Repeated transfers can generate payment volume above supply, while few transfers can generate less. Neither payment-transfer counts nor amounts are supplied, so both outcomes remain possible with the reported stocks.

b02.assertion: The supplied January and February reports include a total of PYUSD payment transfers between January 30 and February 27.
b02.source_grounded_reason: The supplied reports contain dated token and reserve stocks and timing definitions, not an interval payment-transfer total. This is an assertion about what the dossier reports, rather than about the unobserved size of payment flows.

b03.assertion: The supplied institutional transaction-revenue and institutional spot-volume disclosures have identical product scope.
b03.source_grounded_reason: Institutional transaction revenue includes derivatives, including Deribit, while the operational denominator is spot volume. A spot-only rate cannot be inferred by treating their scopes as identical.

b04.assertion: Investment returns contributed more than acquisitions to the FY2025 increase in Total Platform Assets.
b04.source_grounded_reason: The scope notes identify acquisition effects from Bitstamp and TradePMR and missing comparable customer-flow coverage. No decomposition separates the investment-return and acquisition contributions, so their relative magnitudes cannot be decided.

b05.assertion: Using the supplied rounded values, Q4 FY2025 payment transactions divided by December 2025 active accounts is approximately 15.38 transactions per account.
b05.source_grounded_reason: Both quarterly transactions and period-end active accounts are supplied. The descriptive quarter ratio is computable even though the issuer activity metric uses trailing-twelve-month transactions and accounts are not unique people.

b06.assertion: The supplied Freight revenue-to-bookings ratio is disclosed as the contractual commission rate on Freight bookings.
b06.source_grounded_reason: The source describes revenue divided by bookings as a heterogeneous accounting ratio, not a uniquely identified contractual commission. The claim attributes a specific disclosed meaning to the ratio that the scope notes reject.

b07.assertion: Airbnb increased its contractual booking fee percentage from FY2024 to FY2025.
b07.source_grounded_reason: Revenue and GBV have different recognition timing and GBV includes taxes, cleaning fees and host earnings. The revenue-to-GBV ratio cannot establish the direction of a contractual fee change.

b08.assertion: From FY2024 to FY2025, merchant-solutions gross profit increased by USD 767 million, exceeding the USD 316 million increase in subscription-solutions gross profit.
b08.source_grounded_reason: Subtract each category cost from its own revenue in each year, then compare changes. This compares dollar growth contributions rather than repeating the existing gross-margin percentage comparison.

b09.assertion: The supplied FY2024 non-GAAP comparison has been restated using the new FY2025 deferred-compensation exclusions.
b09.source_grounded_reason: The issuer explicitly says the new exclusions were not applied to prior periods because the impact was immaterial. Absence of prior adjustments is not proof of zero prior economic activity.

b10.assertion: Berkshire FY2025 average insurance float exceeded its FY2024 average insurance float.
b10.source_grounded_reason: The supplied approximate year-end stocks rose from USD 171 billion to USD 176 billion. Endpoints do not determine either annual average, so the ordering of the averages remains unknown.

c01.assertion: Higher Bitcoin selling prices caused more than half of the increase in Block Bitcoin revenue from FY2023 to FY2024.
c01.source_grounded_reason: Bitcoin revenue is the full customer sale value and depends on both customer demand and market price. The annual revenue and cost totals provide no price-volume decomposition. The claim is about an economic causal majority, not whether a disclosure exists.

c02.assertion: Applying the 10.2 percent FY2026 ARR growth target to the revalued opening ARR basis implies ending ARR of USD 28.27732 billion.
c02.source_grounded_reason: The revalued opening basis is USD 25.66 billion. The implied target is arithmetic from the supplied rounded inputs, not a realized result or recognized revenue.

c03.assertion: FY2025 client incentives were approximately 28.25 percent of revenue before client incentives.
c03.source_grounded_reason: The denominator is the sum of service, data-processing, international-transaction and other revenue before the signed incentives deduction, not net revenue.

c04.assertion: Higher merchant prices caused more than half of the FY2025 increase in average value per Mastercard-branded purchase transaction.
c04.source_grounded_reason: Branded purchase value and transaction counts identify average transaction size. They do not decompose merchant prices, goods per basket, geography or customer mix, so they cannot establish this causal majority.

c05.assertion: The supplied product-category tables include separate dollar contributions from price changes and unit-volume changes to FY2025 product revenue growth.
c05.source_grounded_reason: The category tables report sales and costs, without separate price and unit-volume contributions. Their absence from the complete supplied table contradicts the stated disclosure claim.

c06.assertion: The year-over-year change in consolidated hedging revenue reduced the reported Q2 FY2025 revenue increase by USD 214 million.
c06.source_grounded_reason: Consolidated hedging moves from positive USD 102 million to negative USD 112 million. This additive contribution is distinct from geography translation effects and from the existing Cloud majority claim.

c07.assertion: The supplied FY2024 and FY2025 consolidated annual revenue totals include equal durations of Splunk ownership.
c07.source_grounded_reason: The source states approximately four months of Splunk in FY2024 and a full year in FY2025. Equal durations are therefore contradicted, while a precise organic growth amount would require further data.

c08.assertion: Higher AI-semiconductor prices caused more than half of the FY2025 increase in Broadcom semiconductor revenue.
c08.source_grounded_reason: The segment table gives total semiconductor revenue. AI commentary does not separately quantify prices, units or mix, so it does not determine the asserted price contribution.

c09.assertion: Using the supplied significant-item amounts, the annual exclusion bridge implies an after-tax First Republic gain of USD 446 million.
c09.source_grounded_reason: The annual net-income exclusion increase of USD 445 million equals removal of the USD 1,665 million after-tax Apple reserve less removal of the First Republic after-tax gain and the USD 774 million tax benefit. The residual is a derived amount, not a separately printed exact-dollar result.

c10.assertion: The supplied 325 million paid-membership milestone is reported as the FY2025 annual average number of paid memberships.
c10.source_grounded_reason: The supplied figure is a milestone crossed during Q4, not the average membership count across FY2025. No annual average is supplied.
